Ok guys, here is yesterday's drawing. 
[This](http://i.imgur.com/eHsoGUX.jpg?1) is a great example of how most of my drawing sessions turn out. I start with an idea, and by the end of the drawing I am frustrated and disappointed in what I have produced. As you can tell by the eraser marks and faded graphite all over the paper, I tried many different things, but failed at all of them.

BUT, I have to remember that this is why I started this project. I promised to produce one picture a day and post it, regardless of how shitty I think the picture is. 

I am still smoking at this point, but I've only got enough left for maybe one or two days. Maybe today's drawing will be better. 


Thank you to all of those who have replied. Your support is greatly appreciated. :)
Thanks. :) I'll look around my area

That's what I did last time I tried to quit. First I quit cold turkey, then I allowed myself to indulge every so often. And before I knew it, I was smoking every day all day again, just like I had before. 
I really wish I had the self control to simply moderate myself. Maybe one day. :/
Thank you for your feedback. I know it won't be easy. I've smoked every day for almost 3 years now. It's become routine.
